title: A Study of the Safety and Effectiveness of JUVÉDERM VOLUMA® XC Injectable Gel for Cheek Augmentation Using Cannula
brief_summary: The objective of this study is to evaluate the safety and effectiveness of JUVÉDERM VOLUMA® XC injectable gel using cannula in participants seeking correction of age-related volume deficit in the mid-face.
condition: Age-related Volume Deficit in the Mid-face
